list.name: profile_id
list.label: Profile
list.description: Selected Project Provider Profile. Metrics derives provider identity, fixed project labels, source query ownership, field bindings, and mapping version using this profile.

list.name: range_mode
list.label: Range Mode
list.description: Controls the provider fetch/cache range. Work Week mode uses Begin WW and End WW as the backend data authority; Date mode uses the Grafana time picker dates.

list.name: begin_ww
list.label: Begin WW
list.description: Start work week for provider fetch/cache in Work Week mode. In Date mode this value is ignored by the Metrics API.

list.name: end_ww
list.label: End WW
list.description: End work week for provider fetch/cache in Work Week mode. In Date mode this value is ignored by the Metrics API.

panels.title: Provider Fetch / Cache Window
panels.description: Provider-side fetch/cache settings decide which provider records Metrics materializes and caches for this dashboard. Work Week mode uses Begin WW and End WW as the authoritative backend range; Date mode uses the Grafana time picker dates.

options.content: **Provider-side fetch/cache:** **Work Week** uses `Begin WW / End WW`; **Date mode** uses time-picker dates.

panels.title: Display Time Window
panels.description: The native Grafana time picker is a display-window control in Work Week mode. The dashboard is aligned at launch/import time, but stock Grafana cannot hard-lock manual picker edits or automatically bind textbox WW changes to the native picker.

options.content: **Display Time Window:** time picker controls visible charts. [Sync Range](http://127.0.0.1:8002/api/provider-profiles/align-dashboard-range/?profile_id=$profile_id&range_mode=$range_mode&begin_ww=$begin_ww&end_ww=$end_ww&begin_date=${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}&end_date=${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}) after WW edits.
